why: Same Panasonic M-A (ECA) family as this board's 10uF, 220uF and 470uF/35V lines (docs/parts/sourcing-notes.md Lessons, 2026-09-30). The straight-lead base part ECA-1VM101 showed 0 Mouser stock on 2026-09-30; the 'I' (2.5mm taping pitch) variant is the same can at the same 2.5mm lead spacing per the datasheet's dimension table (taping i = 2.5mm for this row, matching the straight-lead value) and is in stock (22557 units), so it was chosen over the out-of-stock base SKU.
